| Obligation | Resolution | Status |
|---|---|---|

| image constant and signs | differentiated Poisson summation | proved |
| identity removability | opposite radial images paired before division | proved |
| finite-order differentiation of image sums | Gaussian normal domination | proved |

| logarithm denominators | `1+q >= 1-Q0 > 0` on identity and transition charts | proved and rationally validated |

| action Hessian geometry | radial and tangential eigenvalues on the unit three-sphere | proved |
| cut-chart sign and removability | positive odd-image pairs and the regular factor `J_{b,t}` | proved |
| cut-chart logarithmic derivatives | explicit kernel derivative majorants plus principal-pair lower bound | proved |
| antipodal prefactor | exact endpoint sum and the `S^2` Morse--Bott family | proved |
| normalized tail denominator | character normalization with respect to Haar probability | proved |
| lattice normalization | `T^a=sigma^a/2`, `tau=2t`, and `theta=|X|/2` | proved |

No analytic obligation remains open.  The manuscript explicitly excludes an
interacting-measure, renormalization-group, or mass-gap conclusion.
